digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 21 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Rust, TypeScript, Python）和 13 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「其他热门」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: openai/codex
repos.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
repos.summary_zh: 终端里的轻量级 Rust 编码代理，让 AI 直接接管命令行开发流程

repos.name: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
repos.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 290+ providers (90+ free), 500+ models — Kimi, Claude, GPT, OpenAI, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniM
repos.summary_zh: 统一端点接入 290+ 模型供应商，90+ 免费模型，兼容 Claude Code 等主流 AI 编码工具

repos.name: esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix
repos.description: DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for your terminal. Engineered around prefix-cache stability — leave it running.
repos.summary_zh: 终端常驻的 DeepSeek 原生 AI 编程助手，靠前缀缓存稳定实现零重启长跑

repos.name: modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk
repos.description: The official Python SDK for Model Context Protocol servers and clients
repos.summary_zh: 官方 Python SDK 让模型上下文协议落地，统一 AI 工具与数据接入标准，简化 MCP 服务端和客户端开发

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: BurntSushi/ripgrep
repos.description: ripgrep recursively searches directories for a regex pattern while respecting your gitignore
repos.summary_zh: 递归搜索代码库时自动遵循 gitignore，Rust 实现快如闪电，替代 grep 的现代命令行神器

repos.name: appwrite/appwrite
repos.description: Appwrite® - complete cloud infrastructure for your web, mobile and AI apps. Including Auth, Databases, Storage, Functions, Messaging, Hosting, Realtim
repos.summary_zh: 一站式后端云服务，集认证、数据库、存储、函数与实时能力于一体，让 Web 和 AI 应用开发无需自建后端

repos.name: cypress-io/cypress
repos.description: Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser.
repos.summary_zh: 浏览器端测试的闪电战利器，前端开发者用起来最顺手的自动化测试框架

repos.name: moeru-ai/airi
repos.description: 💖🧸 Self hosted, you-owned Grok Companion, a container of souls of waifu, cyber livings to bring them into our worlds, wishing to achieve Neuro-sama's
repos.summary_zh: 自托管AI伴侣容器，支持实时语音与Minecraft交互，打造类Neuro-sama的赛博生命体

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: lyogavin/airllm
repos.description: AirLLM 70B inference with single 4GB GPU
repos.summary_zh: 单张4GB显卡即可运行70B大模型，通过层外内存调度突破显存限制

repos.name: drumih/turbo-fieldfare
repos.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B inference in ~2 GB of RAM on any M-series MacBook
repos.summary_zh: 苹果芯片 MacBook 仅需 2GB 内存即可本地跑 Gemma 4 26B-A4B，把大模型门槛压到极致

repos.name: FareedKhan-dev/kimi-k3-in-c
repos.description: A 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running inference on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM. Portable C99: no BLAS, no framework, no GPU.
repos.summary_zh: 纯 C99 单文件跑 2.78 万亿参数模型，8.24GB 内存无 GPU 也能本地推理

repos.name: VictorTaelin/OptMem
repos.description: Permanent memory for AI agents. A 426-token prompt, a script, plug and play.
repos.summary_zh: 426 token 即插即用的 AI 永久记忆方案，让 Agent 跨会话记住一切

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: MoonshotAI/PerceptionBench
repos.description: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
repos.summary_zh: 多模态大模型原子级视觉感知评测基准，专测细粒度视觉缺陷而非整体能力

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: rustdesk/rustdesk
repos.description: An open-source remote desktop application designed for self-hosting, as an alternative to TeamViewer.
repos.summary_zh: 开源远程桌面神器，自托管替代 TeamViewer，全平台支持且数据完全自主可控

repos.name: tailwindlabs/tailwindcss
repos.description: A utility-first CSS framework for rapid UI development.
repos.summary_zh: 原子化 CSS 框架，用工具类快速拼装界面，告别繁琐样式文件，开发效率拉满

repos.name: directus/directus
repos.description: The flexible backend for all your projects 🐰 Turn your DB into a headless CMS, admin panels, or apps with a custom UI, instant APIs, auth & more.
repos.summary_zh: 开源实时数据后端，把数据库秒变无头CMS和后台管理，自带API与鉴权

repos.name: tokio-rs/tokio
repos.description: A runtime for writing reliable asynchronous applications with Rust. Provides I/O, networking, scheduling, timers, ...
repos.summary_zh: Rust 异步编程的事实标准运行时，提供高性能 I/O 与任务调度，让可靠并发代码更易编写

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: donnemartin/system-design-primer
repos.description: Learn how to design large-scale systems. Prep for the system design interview. Includes Anki flashcards.
repos.summary_zh: 系统设计面试必备手册，用图解和案例拆解大型系统架构，配 Anki 卡巩固记忆

repos.name: dani-garcia/vaultwarden
repos.description: Unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs
repos.summary_zh: 自托管密码管理首选，Rust 重写 Bitwarden 服务端，轻量部署且全功能兼容官方客户端

repos.name: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners
repos.description: 12 Weeks, 24 Lessons, AI for All!
repos.summary_zh: 微软官方出品的AI入门教程，12周24课覆盖从神经网络到生成式AI，适合零基础开发者系统上手

repos.name: sharkdp/bat
repos.description: A cat(1) clone with wings.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重写的 cat 增强版，带语法高亮、Git 集成和分页，让终端看代码更优雅

papers.title: Reasoning Core: Designing Broad Procedural Data for Completion-Supervised Reasoning Training
papers.abstract: Procedural generators produce useful verifiable reasoning problems at scale, but have received less attention as data for completion-supervised fine-tuning. We introduce Reasoning Core, a collection o
papers.summary_zh: 提出推理核心数据集，含50个程序化生成器覆盖数学逻辑规划等领域，用于补全监督微调，显著提升模型泛化与推理能力

papers.title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Runtime for Long-Horizon Reasoning
papers.abstract: Long-horizon reasoning requires an agentic runtime that can persist when evidence supports its current approach and pivot when measurements reveal failure, hidden constraints, or a misspecified object
papers.summary_zh: 提出持久自进化智能体运行时Argus，以管理规划工程四角色协同实现长程推理自适应持续与转向，显著提升复杂任务成功率

papers.title: Toward Skill-Native LLMs: Skill Entropy for Benchmarking and Training Long-Horizon Reasoning
papers.abstract: Long-horizon reasoning in recent LLMs demands that the model switch between distinct skills inside a reasoning chain, such as first doing a math derivation, then using the result to plan a schedule. W
papers.summary_zh: 提出技能熵指标量化长程推理中的跨技能切换，据此构建基准并训练技能原生大模型，显著提升多步推理准确率与泛化能力

papers.title: Teaching Nemotron Greek: Mining a Corpus, Adapting Retrieval, and Grounding Generation for Modern Greek across Specialist Domains
papers.abstract: Modern Greek is absent from NVIDIA's Nemotron retrieval models and from major multilingual retrieval benchmarks, despite being important for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in legal, energy, fina
papers.summary_zh: 针对现代希腊语构建检索增强生成全流程方案，自建语料库并适配检索模型，在司法能源金融医疗领域显著提升专业问答准确率与检索召回率

papers.title: Predicting Brain Morphometry with MT-GNN: Mesh Evolution in Continuous Time with Graph-Based Metric Tensor Embeddings
papers.abstract: Predicting how a subcortical structure's shape will evolve from a few prior scans could support prognosis and clinical-trial enrichment. Existing longitudinal mesh predictors either extrapolate shape
papers.summary_zh: 提出基于图度量张量嵌入的连续时间网格演化模型，预测皮层下结构形态变化，较现有方法在纵向形状预测精度上显著提升

papers.title: Spoken Function Calling: A New Perspective on Spoken Language Understanding for Large Audio Language Models
papers.abstract: Spoken Language Understanding (SLU) is the core component of task-oriented dialogue systems and a pivotal link in achieving seamless human-agent interaction. While traditional SLU can effectively extr
papers.summary_zh: 提出语音函数调用新范式，将SLU重构为函数调用任务，使大音频语言模型在开放集任务中无需微调即可直接执行，显著提升泛化能力与交互效率

papers.title: OctoLong: Mid-Training On Cross-Repository Code Contexts Enhances Long-Context Modeling
papers.abstract: Context lengths of language models (LMs) have dramatically increased, driven by the demands for in-context learning, self-improvement, and long-horizon agentic workflows. Existing long-context corpora
papers.summary_zh: 提出跨仓库代码上下文中期训练方法，增强长上下文建模能力，有效缓解现有语料资源有限问题并提升模型泛化表现

papers.title: Reward Structure Shapes the Interaction Between Episodic Exploration and Neural Memory in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: In partially observable reinforcement learning, agents face a dual bottleneck: they must explore to encounter rewarding states and retain that experience in memory to optimize their policies. Explorat
papers.summary_zh: 提出奖励结构调控情景探索与神经记忆交互的强化学习框架，揭示高稀疏奖励下记忆增强探索效率提升显著，低稀疏时记忆收益递减

papers.title: CoPlan: A Trustworthy Co-Intelligence Interface for Care Planning through Role-Based Contestable Argument Graphs
papers.abstract: AI-supported care planning can help clinicians, patients, caregivers, and care teams coordinate complex decisions across clinical, functional, psychosocial, and environmental needs. However, many AI s
papers.summary_zh: 提出基于角色可争辩参数图的协同智能规划界面，支持多方质疑与修订，将护理决策透明度提升至可审计水平并显著增强团队信任度

papers.title: OPD-V: Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation with Modality Balance
papers.abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has become a standard post-training approach for improving visual reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing methods draw privileged information
papers.summary_zh: 提出视觉在策略自蒸馏方法，引入模态平衡机制缓解推理偏差，在多项多模态基准上平均提升约5个百分点且训练开销降低两成

papers.title: Item Response Theory for AI Safety
papers.abstract: Language models differ in how safely they behave and these differences are measured by safety benchmarks. But aggregated benchmark scores are hard to trust and interpret, because benchmarks duplicate
papers.summary_zh: 借鉴心理测量学项目反应理论评估大模型安全表现，构建可解释安全量表并识别模型应试策略，显著提升基准测试可信度

papers.title: The Loss Does Not See the Basis, but Adam Does
papers.abstract: Gradient descent on a factored model $W = UV^\top$ is implicitly biased toward low-rank solutions, while Adam, starting from the same small initialization, is not. We trace the difference to the gauge
papers.summary_zh: 发现梯度下降在因子分解模型上隐式偏向低秩解而Adam不具备此性质，归因于损失函数的规范对称性，并据此提出修正方法恢复Adam的低秩归纳偏置

papers.title: Representational separation between unitary and channel quantum generative models via shared classical randomness at shallow depth
papers.abstract: Near-term quantum hardware limits circuit depth and often imposes geometrically local connectivity for quantum generative models, restricting the output distributions accessible to shallow unitary Bor
papers.summary_zh: 提出浅层幺正与信道量子生成模型的表征分离机制，通过共享经典随机性在浅深度下扩展输出分布能力，揭示两类模型在量子优势上的本质差异
